faq.question: Q1. What is the organization conducting this recruitment?
faq.answer: The recruitment is conducted by the Goa State Scheduled Tribes Finance and Development Corporation (GSSTFDCL) for filling up vacant positions under their department in Goa state.

faq.question: Q2. What is the name of the post advertised by GSSTFDCL?
faq.answer: The advertised post is Company Secretary, aimed at hiring qualified professionals on a contract basis to manage corporate secretarial tasks and responsibilities within the corporation efficiently.

faq.question: Q3. How many vacancies are available in this notification?
faq.answer: A total of 1 vacancy has been released under this recruitment notification for the Company Secretary post, offering a great opportunity for eligible candidates.

faq.question: Q4. What is the mode of application for GSSTFDCL recruitment?
faq.answer: The application mode is strictly offline. Interested candidates must download the prescribed application form, fill it out completely, and send it to the designated official address.

faq.question: Q5. What is the last date to submit the offline application?
faq.answer: The last date for the submission of completed offline application forms is 10-10-2026. Candidates must ensure their applications reach well before this deadline to avoid rejection.

faq.question: Q6. What educational qualifications are required for the post?
faq.answer: Candidates must be an Associate Member or Fellow of the Institute of Company Secretaries of India (ICSI) and hold a Graduation degree from a recognized university along with Konkani knowledge.

faq.question: Q7. What is the age limit for the Company Secretary post?
faq.answer: Applicants must not be less than 18 years and should not exceed 45 years of age. Upper age relaxations are applicable for eligible categories like Government Servants.

faq.question: Q8. What is the monthly salary offered for this position?
faq.answer: Selected candidates for the Company Secretary position will receive a consolidated monthly remuneration of ₹50,000/- throughout their contract tenure with the corporation.

faq.question: Q9. Where can I download the official notification and application form?
faq.answer: The official notification and application form can be downloaded directly from the official website of the corporation at www.gsstfdcl.in or via the direct links provided.

faq.question: Q10. What is the job type and duration for this recruitment?
faq.answer: This recruitment is purely on a contract basis for a duration of 1 year, providing professional exposure within a government-backed financial and development corporation in Panaji, Goa.
